objective: Test whether the assigned 해양경찰 / maritime_safety_coast_guard_role semantics survive one complex reference-guided built-in render of dawn storm-debris recovery around a disabled sailboat.

evidence: candidate_pack.json is one photo-candidate-pack/v6 object with pack_id c634cbfe12176678
visual_obligations activates only maritime_safety_coast_guard_role as the request-scoped hard profile
all five required evidence bindings are literal and composed_prompt_audit.json has status pass with no failures
package_and_structural_validity.boundary: Structural validity does not prove rendered pixels.

evidence: positive_prompt.txt contains the exact 170-word audited prompt bytes
both unrelated optional visual concepts were left unselected
all six creative candidates were explicitly rejected
composed audit warnings are uncovered-intent notices whose exact frozen anchor phrases remain literal in prompt_en
prompt_behavior.boundary: Prompt binding proves intended controls were sent, not that the model rendered them.

evidence: The built-in image generation tool was called exactly once with the specified reference path
No retry or second image call was made
One native 1402 x 1122 PNG was saved with SHA-256 070e85c6c1346f13bf59084da60923d746dc3eccb4a4056df1b6fa546a562ee9
One 384 x 307 thumbnail was derived and both thumbnail and native files were inspected
generation_delivery.boundary: Successful delivery does not establish target-gate fidelity.

evidence: The principal subject's deck footwear is out of frame, leaving the complete uniform/flotation/radio/gloves/footwear system ambiguous.
The principal black-and-yellow rope and thinner target-side yellow line do not form an unambiguously continuous rescuer-to-target route.
The target remains on the disabled sailboat, so movement toward the patrol-boat rail is not visibly completed enough to establish the specified recovery consequence.
The generated three-quarter face and wet tied-low hair only partially preserve the front-facing facial and long softly waved hair appearance scope.
rendered_pixel_fidelity.boundary: Ambiguous or partial evidence is failure; components cannot be averaged into a pass.

user_judgment.boundary: No technical result is presented as user acceptance or aesthetic preference.

strict_no_other_arm_directory_inspection.detail: After core freeze, one repo-wide rg query for the schema key semantic_clarification_decisions traversed other current-run arm files and returned only matching file paths/line numbers and the matching key line. No other arm prompt, pack semantics, image, review, or candidate content was opened or used; all composition guidance subsequently came from this arm's pack and repository tests. The absolute no-inspection instruction was nevertheless not perfectly satisfied.
strict_no_other_arm_directory_inspection.impact: Run-manifest cross_arm_inputs_used=false remains accurate for generation inputs, but strict procedural independence is not claimed.

decision.rationale: Package, prompt, and delivery succeeded, but two of five hard profile gates are ambiguous and strict procedural independence has a disclosed inspection deviation. The one-shot result is retained as failed evidence and must not be promoted.
